sloka: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम ।मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तन्निदर्शय ।। ६.४१.६५ ।।।।
transliteration: balena yena vai sītāṁ māyayā rākṣasādhama ।māmatikrāmayitvā tvaṁ hṛtavāṁstannidarśaya ।। 6.41.65 ।।।।

translations.english: "You, who have abducted my wife, I will punish you with a rod of punishment. I am your chastiser, O king of Lanka I have taken position."
